_doc: Rocket tiers (Mk I-IV), bought in the workbench Rockets tab. Mk I comes with a level 5 base. countdown_s/sequence: shorter launch cinematic; flight_s: globe flight; recharge_s: energy cells refill after a launch before the next one; cargo_mult/cargo_period_s: Rocket Cargo pods (automation/cargo.gd); warp: instant hop (no countdown, a flash).

tiers.name: Mk I Cradle
tiers.desc: Pearl hull, three swept fins, one cyan engine.

tiers.name: Mk II Glide
tiers.desc: A hover ring stabilises the climb: shorter countdown, faster flight, cells refill twice as fast. Cargo pods carry 50% more.

tiers.name: Mk III Halo
tiers.desc: Twin side boosters and a second ring. Cells refill in a minute; cargo pods carry 2.5x, more often.

tiers.name: Mk IV Aurora Warp
tiers.desc: Energy fins and a warp core: instant hops with no recharge. Cargo pods carry 4x, every 30 s.
